name: youtube-downloader-chrome-extension
description: Chrome extension that downloads YouTube videos/audio through a local yt-dlp helper.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ytdl/host && npm run build -w @ytdl/extension
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @ytdl/host && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/host && tsc -p packages/extension
